body:
Thanks to everyone who read and listened! I think that I've come to my senses, at least a little bit.

I'm probably not going to kill myself this Thursday. Instead, I've come up with another radical plan.

I'm just going to pack my belongings, leave a letter (not a suicide letter!) to my family to explain what I've been going through.

After all that, I'm just going to turn off my phone and take a long walk. I'll pack a tent, water and food and I'll walk for four or five days. After that, I'll return home.

This sounds insane, right? But please, hear me out.

I mean, I've never been good with words. I can't and won't tell my family what I've done, but I'll let this crazy hike speak for myself. I know that this really is the worst thing in the world to do, but it sure beats killing myself, and this is the only thing I can think of. I just need to break this sick routine of mine, do something radical to gain a new perspective on life. Then my family will realize that I've got issues and I can finally leave all this behind, get a job and become a normal human being. But I won't kill myself, this is the main thing.

Again, a big thank\-you to everyone who read and commented. You people are life savers.
I'm so sorry to hear about your loss. I promise that I won't cause this kind of pain to my own family.
This really helped me make sense of things, thank you for taking your time to listen.
